items.raw_excerpt: The “maxxing” trend encapsulates our increasingly intense optimisation culture, but it could actually be having the opposite affect.
items.summary_en: The trend of "maxxing" is becoming more popular. It means trying to optimize every part of life. But this obsession might actually make us more stressed.

items.raw_excerpt: La diputada Tania Caballero Navarro, presidenta de la Jucopo, anunció la entrega de la Iniciativa de Reforma Integral a la Constitución del Estado, resaltando la…
items.summary_en: A state deputy in Oaxaca announced she delivered a comprehensive constitutional reform initiative to the state legislature. She said the new constitution must recognize the people and be built by listening to them. The reform aims to include social justice at its core.
items.summary_ko: 오아하카주의 주의원 타냐 카바예로 나바로가 주 헌법 전면 개정안을 의회에 제출했다고 발표했다. 그녀는 새 헌법이 주민의 권리를 인정하고, 사람들의 목소리를 듣고 함께 만들어야 한다고 강조했다. 개혁의 핵심은 사회 정의를 헌법에 반영하는 것이다.
